Callout.Name: Dumped Chemicals
Callout.Message: Drums dumped at a beauty spot.

Script.Line: Six drums and two of them are leaking.
It is at the beauty spot, right beside the picnic table.
Do not touch them. That is my advice and I am sticking to it.

Lines.Approach: Drums tipped over the edge and something coming out of them. Do not touch them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
